OCF-BOD-001.description: Supports balanced brain and neck circulation and maintenance, with conscious reinforcement when desired.

texts.opener:
This OCF exercise will teach you to strengthen healthy circulation
and natural maintenance throughout your brain
and the blood vessels in your neck that supply it,
supporting clear thinking and mental sharpness.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let healthy circulation, renewal,
and maintenance work together throughout your brain
and the blood vessels in your neck that supply it.

Let blood flow smoothly and evenly,
carrying oxygen and nourishment to every part of your brain.
Let these pathways remain open, strong, and flexible,
with renewal and maintenance working together in natural balance.

This pattern is permanently established within you
and continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep,
adjusting to your body's needs without conscious effort.

Your mind becomes clearer, your thinking sharper,
and your concentration steadier.
Your thoughts flow smoothly,
and your responses become quicker and more precise.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this pattern, simply close your eyes.
Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.
While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Brain Flow."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently
blowing out a candle, and open your eyes.

As you exhale, let this pattern of healthy circulation, renewal,
and maintenance continue throughout your brain and neck.

The more you use this command,
the easier and more effective this reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce healthy circulation and maintenance
in your brain and neck, close your eyes.
Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
Silently say to yourself, "Plus Brain Flow."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently
blowing out a candle, and open your eyes.

This concludes your OCF Brain Flow exercise.

OCF-BOD-006.description: A self-directed practice focused on steady, coordinated heart function, healthy circulation, and ongoing natural maintenance, with conscious reinforcement when desired.

texts.opener:
This OCF exercise will teach you to reinforce steady,
coordinated heart function, healthy circulation,
and your heart's natural renewal and maintenance.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let your heart's natural strength,
coordination, circulation, and maintenance work together
in lasting balance.

Let its muscles work smoothly and efficiently,
with the strength needed to circulate blood without unnecessary strain.
Let the signals guiding each heartbeat remain clear and coordinated,
bringing the heart's activity into a steady, balanced rhythm.

Let the blood vessels within and around your heart
remain open, strong, and flexible,
supplying the oxygen and nourishment it needs.
Let renewal and maintenance support every part of your heart.

Your heart responds naturally to your body's changing needs,
increasing its activity when needed
and returning to an easy rhythm during rest.

This pattern is permanently established within you
and continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep,
without conscious effort.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this pattern, simply close your eyes.
Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.
While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Heart Flow."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

The more you use this command,
the easier and more effective this reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce healthy heart function,
circulation, and maintenance, close your eyes.
Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
Silently say to yourself, "Plus Heart Flow."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

This concludes your OCF Heart Flow exercise.

OCF-BOD-003.description: A self-directed practice for easing physical discomfort in a selected area of the body.

texts.opener:
This OCF exercise will teach you to ease physical discomfort
in a selected area of your body.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, whenever you wish to ease physical discomfort,
you can use this method to bring comfort to the area you choose.

Close your eyes and bring the area where you want comfort into your awareness.
Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.
While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Comfort."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, let discomfort ease,
becoming less intense and less demanding of your attention.
Let your body settle into comfort and relaxation,
while your mind remains calm, clear, and peaceful.

You remain aware of your body's needs
and free to focus on what you choose.

The more you use this command,
the easier and more effective this response becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember this method for easing physical discomfort.
Close your eyes and bring the area where you want comfort into your awareness.
Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
Silently say to yourself, "Plus Comfort."
Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

This concludes your OCF Comfort exercise.

OCF-SLP-002.description: A self-directed practice for entering natural, restful sleep through relaxation and a simple mental command.

texts.opener: This OCF exercise will teach you to enter normal, natural, restful sleep whenever you choose, and awaken at the time you desire.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, you have the ability to enter normal, natural, restful sleep whenever you choose.

When you are ready for sleep, make yourself comfortable and allow your body and mind to begin relaxing.

Simply close your eyes.
Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.
While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Sleep."
Then slowly exhale and continue breathing naturally.

As you exhale, allow yourself to move more deeply into peaceful, natural sleep.

Your thoughts become quiet. Unnecessary effort and tension fade away. Your mind and body recognize that the time for sleep has arrived.

You fall asleep smoothly and naturally, without needing to force the process.

Throughout your sleep, your mind and body settle into their natural rhythms of rest, balance, maintenance, and renewal.

You enjoy the restful sleep you desire, awakening at your chosen time, refreshed, alert, and ready for the day ahead.

This ability remains available whenever you consciously choose to use it. At other times, your ordinary waking awareness remains clear and active.

Each time you use "Plus Sleep," entering natural sleep becomes easier and more familiar.
texts.closer:
Remember, whenever you wish to enter normal, natural, restful sleep, close your eyes.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.
While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Sleep."
Then slowly exhale and continue breathing naturally.

Allow yourself to settle into restful sleep.

This concludes your OCF Sleep exercise.

texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let your body's natural processes of cleansing, renewal, and maintenance work together smoothly and efficiently.

Your liver, kidneys, lungs, digestive system, and other natural cleansing pathways each perform their important work.

Let your body retain and use what is beneficial, while processing and eliminating natural waste products and substances it no longer needs.

Let every organ, tissue, and supporting system work together in healthy balance, providing nourishment, protection, maintenance, and renewal throughout your body.

This pattern is permanently established within you and continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep, adjusting naturally to your body's changing needs without conscious effort.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this pattern, simply close your eyes.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself, "Plus Detox."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, let this pattern of natural cleansing, renewal, and maintenance continue throughout your body.

The more you use this command, the easier and more effective this reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce your body's natural cleansing, renewal, and maintenance, close your eyes.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Silently say to yourself, "Plus Detox."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle.

This concludes your OCF Detox exercise.

OCF-BOD-002.description: A self-directed practice focused on healthy circulation throughout the body, supporting smooth blood flow, oxygen and nutrient delivery, blood vessel maintenance, and natural renewal, with conscious reinforcement when desired.

texts.opener: This OCF exercise will teach you to strengthen healthy circulation throughout your entire body, supporting smooth blood flow, nourishment, renewal, and natural maintenance.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let healthy circulation, nourishment, renewal, and maintenance work together throughout your entire body.

Let your blood flow smoothly and evenly through your arteries, veins, and smaller blood vessels, carrying oxygen and nourishment wherever they are needed.

Let these pathways remain open, strong, and flexible, supporting steady and efficient circulation.

Your lungs supply oxygen, and your digestive system provides nourishment. Your blood carries these essential resources throughout your body, while your kidneys, liver, lungs, and other natural systems help process waste and maintain healthy balance.

Every organ and tissue receives the circulation and nourishment it needs, with blood flow adjusting naturally to your body's changing demands.

This pattern is permanently established within you and continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep, without conscious effort.

Your body's natural circulation and maintenance systems work together smoothly, supporting strength, balance, renewal, and vitality throughout your everyday life.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this pattern, simply close your eyes.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself, "Plus Circulate."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, let this pattern of smooth, balanced circulation and natural maintenance continue throughout your entire body.

The more you use this command, the easier and more effective this reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce healthy circulation and natural maintenance throughout your body, close your eyes.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Silently say to yourself, "Plus Circulate."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle, and open your eyes.

This concludes your OCF Circulation exercise.

OCF-BOD-007.description: A self-directed practice focused on supporting healthy blood pressure regulation, coordinated heart and blood vessel function, and natural cardiovascular balance that adapts to the body's changing needs, with conscious reinforcement when desired.

texts.opener: This OCF exercise will teach you to reinforce your body's natural ability to regulate blood pressure, supporting healthy circulation, cardiovascular balance, and coordinated heart and blood vessel function.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let your body's natural systems of blood pressure regulation, circulation, and cardiovascular maintenance work together in healthy balance.

Let your heart and blood vessels work smoothly and efficiently, supporting the circulation of oxygen and nourishment throughout your body.

Let your blood vessels remain healthy, strong, and naturally flexible, responding appropriately to your body's changing needs.

When you are resting, let your cardiovascular system settle into calm, comfortable, and efficient activity.

When you are active, let your heart and blood vessels adjust naturally, providing the circulation and support your body requires.

Let unnecessary physical tension ease, allowing your breathing, muscles, and mind to return to a comfortable, balanced state.

This pattern of healthy cardiovascular regulation and maintenance is permanently established within you.

It continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep, adjusting to your body's needs without conscious effort.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this established pattern, simply close your eyes.

Take a comfortable breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Balance Blood Pressure."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, let your heart and blood vessels continue working together in natural balance, supporting healthy circulation and appropriate blood pressure regulation.

The more you use this command, the easier and more effective this conscious reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce your body's natural blood pressure regulation and cardiovascular balance, close your eyes.

Inhale comfortably and gently hold your breath.

Silently say to yourself,
"Plus Balance Blood Pressure."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle.

This concludes your OCF Blood Pressure Balance exercise.

OCF-SLP-001.description: A self-directed practice focused on deep, restorative sleep, supporting the body's natural processes of healing, repair, renewal, and regeneration throughout sleep, with optional attention to specific areas when desired.

texts.opener: This OCF exercise will teach you to direct your total self toward deep restoration, healing, repair, and regeneration throughout your natural sleep.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, whenever you prepare for sleep, you can direct your total self toward deep healing, restoration, and regeneration throughout your rest.

Let this intention extend throughout your entire body and being. If there is a particular area you wish to restore, you may include it in your intention.

When you are ready, simply close your eyes.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Restorative Sleep."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle, and continue breathing naturally.

Allow yourself to move easily into deep, peaceful, natural sleep.

As your conscious mind rests, let your subconscious mind, higher self, and physical body work together, directing their natural resources toward healing, repair, renewal, and regeneration.

Let your body's natural maintenance and restorative processes work in harmony, supporting balance, recovery, and renewed vitality throughout your entire being.

Areas of weariness, strain, or imbalance receive the care and attention needed for natural restoration.

This restorative pattern continues automatically throughout your sleep, without requiring conscious direction, observation, or effort.

As your sleep is complete, awaken naturally, deeply rested and refreshed, with renewed energy, clarity, and strength.

Your ability to invoke this restorative sleep pattern remains permanently available whenever you choose. Each use makes entering restorative sleep and directing your total self toward renewal easier and more familiar.
texts.closer:
Remember, whenever you wish to direct your total self toward healing, restoration, and regeneration during sleep, simply close your eyes.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Silently say to yourself,
"Plus Restorative Sleep."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently blowing out a candle, and continue resting naturally.

This concludes your OCF Restorative Sleep exercise.

OCF-BOD-009.description: Supports efficient breathing and respiratory maintenance, with conscious reinforcement when desired.

texts.opener: This OCF exercise will teach you to strengthen your respiratory system's natural processes of breathing, renewal, and maintenance, establishing a lasting, automatic pattern of healthy, efficient breathing.
texts.function-body:
From this moment forward, let your entire respiratory system become stronger, healthier, and more efficient.

Let your nose, throat, airways, and lungs work together smoothly, providing the oxygen your body needs.

Let your nasal passages remain clear and comfortable, warming and moistening incoming air, while tiny protective cilia help carry mucus and trapped particles out of your airways.

Let your airways remain open and flexible, allowing air to move smoothly and naturally.

Within your lungs, millions of tiny air sacs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide. Oxygen enters your bloodstream to nourish your body, while carbon dioxide passes into your lungs to be released as you exhale.

Let this exchange remain smooth, balanced, and efficient.

Your diaphragm and breathing muscles work together with natural strength and coordination, allowing you to breathe comfortably without unnecessary effort.

Your body's natural processes of maintenance and renewal support the strength, flexibility, and healthy function of your entire respiratory system.

This pattern of efficient breathing and respiratory maintenance is permanently established within you.

It continues automatically, whether you are awake, resting, or asleep, adjusting naturally to your body's changing needs without conscious effort.

Whenever you wish to reinforce this established pattern, take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Breathe Better."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth.

As you exhale, let this pattern of smooth, efficient breathing and natural respiratory maintenance continue throughout your body.

The more you use this command, the easier and more effective this reinforcement becomes.
texts.closer:
Remember, to reinforce healthy breathing and your respiratory system's natural maintenance, inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Silently say to yourself,
"Plus Breathe Better."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth.

This concludes your OCF Breathe Better exercise.
